positions.name: MissingIdHandling
positions.frame: how should the system handle a markdown heading that arrives without an id field?
positions.why: Both expressions address the same missing-id failure pattern: src-1 asserts the reproduction of the production defect (a ## heading with no id), and src-2 issues the non-negotiable requirements the fix must satisfy (no crash, valid slug). The conviction gradient — src-1 a plain claim, src-2 a decision-grade commitment — is held in tension under one read: what the system must do when the id is absent.
